## Rules for every assignment

- Use TensorFlow Probability (TFP) with the JAX substrate for distributions.
- Use JAX for automatic differentiation and vectorised code.
- Work in groups of two.
- Submit a single Jupyter notebook.
- Draw insights from your results rather than only presenting answers. For example, if a question asks you to try a different likelihood, observe how it compares with the default likelihood.
